funFacts: Lando Norris secured his fifth pole position of the season with a track record lap of 1:29.525 around Marina Bay.
Max Verstappen produced a sublime final sector to claim P2 on the grid, just 0.203 seconds off pole.
Carlos Sainz crashed heavily at Turn 19 during Q3, bringing out a red flag and resigning Ferrari to a P9 and P10 start.

headline: Singapore GP: Lando Norris storms to sensational pole position ahead of Verstappen and Hamilton
whyCareReason: Lando Norris delivers a flawless Q3 flying lap to seize pole position in Singapore, setting up a blockbuster front-row duel with Max Verstappen on Sunday.
teaser: Saturday 3 October under Marina Bay floodlights: Norris clocks 1:29.525 to capture pole. Verstappen starts second, Hamilton third, as Sainz crash disrupts Q3.
story:
Why this one matters: Saturday qualifying at the Singapore Grand Prix produced high drama under the Marina Bay night sky, culminating in a masterclass flying lap from McLaren's Lando Norris.

Norris conquered the unforgiving 19-turn street circuit with a surgical lap of 1:29.525, finishing two-tenths clear of championship rival Max Verstappen. The Dutchman wrestled his Red Bull onto the front row with a courageous final sector, while Lewis Hamilton turned in a stellar qualifying effort to place Ferrari in third.

The final Q3 shootout was interrupted by a violent crash from Carlos Sainz, who spun backwards into the barriers at Turn 19, bringing out a red flag. Charles Leclerc had his lap time deleted for exceeding track limits at Turn 2, leaving Ferrari with a frustrating fifth-row starting position for Sunday's 62-lap night race.
stakes: Pole position at Marina Bay is the most coveted advantage on the F1 calendar, where overtaking is notoriously grueling and safety cars are frequent.
rivalryAngle: Norris vs Verstappen on the front row renews their fierce championship battle under 1,600 dazzling floodlights.
